run_stack_video_cli: run the StackVideo CLI to compare EgoLifter render and feature images against a baseline
build_comparison_video: build a side-by-side comparison video of render and feature PCA images from two folders
create_folder_to_clip: create an ImageSequenceClip from a folder of images using natural sort order
add_text_overlay_to_clip: add a white text overlay to the top-left corner of a video clip
combine_clips_into_grid: combine four video clips into a 2x2 grid and export as an MP4 file
